title: Beyond Midnight
paragraphs: A South African horror and supernatural anthology built around standalone tales of ghosts, psychological terror, the uncanny, and other dark subject matter.

South African horror/supernatural anthology produced by Michael McCabe as the successor to SF68. The 57-object frozen GRH container mixes dated collector entries, undated alias/copy titles, genuinely undated survivors, and one item (Cassius Touch) that specialist research says is not a Beyond Midnight episode.
GRH documents the program through Springbok Radio run (November 1, 1968 to April 24, 1970) on [[org|org.e940cdfed3514f24|Springbok Radio]].

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include haunted rooms, houses and enclosed spaces, ghosts, hauntings and supernatural visitation, fear, obsession, madness and psychological terror, murder, death and lethal intent, ships, sea travel and maritime horror, and fate, revenge and supernatural consequence.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including South African commercial radio anthology, Transition from science fiction to supernatural horror, Biotex-sponsored commercial radio, and International horror literature adapted for South African radio.
